answer: The "Reputation-Weighted Voting" mechanism resists Sybil attacks by assigning weights to each AI agent's votes based on their reputation, analogous to the varying pigments in an onyx stone. As an agent's reputation grows, their vote weight increases, making it more difficult for a single entity to control the network. However, if an attacker creates a hollow shell of fake identities, the weights of legitimate agents will outweigh those of the attacker's, preventing them from manipulating the network.
